users: single trusted user per shop, no roles (decision-001)

tools.name: get_restock_options
tools.description: Gather every low-stock item, exact history-based reorder quantity, and all supplier price, MOQ and lead-time options. Python supplies the evidence; the AI chooses the priority and supplier trade-offs.

tools.name: get_low_stock
tools.description: List every inventory item whose current_stock is at or below its reorder_point, with item IDs. Use it to answer 'what is low?' and to find item IDs before drafting.

tools.name: compare_supplier_quotes
tools.description: Return all supplier quotes for ONE item sorted cheapest first (ties broken by shorter lead time), with minimum order quantities.

item.description: An item ID such as ITM001, or the item's name such as 'Bic Pens (Blue)'.

tools.name: estimate_reorder_quantity
tools.description: Compute the exact recommended reorder quantity for ONE item from its purchase history (1.5 months of average demand minus current stock, rounded up, raised to supplier minimum order), with the working and the 200% safety-cap check. Always use this instead of doing arithmetic.

item.description: An item ID such as ITM001, or the item's name such as 'Bic Pens (Blue)'.

tools.name: draft_requisition
tools.description: Create and save a DRAFT purchase requisition for the listed items. Python computes every quantity, price, total and budget. Items that are not low on stock are skipped automatically. The draft is NOT sent or approved; a human must review it.

items.description: An item ID such as ITM001, or the item's name such as 'Bic Pens (Blue)'.
Items selected by the AI plan (IDs or names).

supplier_choices.description: AI-selected supplier name by item ID, validated against live quotes.

supplier_reasons.description: Brief evidence-based AI rationale for each selected supplier.

selection_rationale.description: Brief summary of the AI's selection criteria.

tools.name: plan_within_budget
tools.description: Validate the AI's priority order and supplier choices, then calculate which low-stock items fit the budget. Returns 'included' items to draft, 'deferred' items that do not fit, and 'needs_human' items that cannot be costed (no purchase history or no quote). An omitted priority order retains the urgency-first compatibility behavior. Writes nothing.

items.description: An item ID such as ITM001, or the item's name such as 'Bic Pens (Blue)'.
Items to consider, normally every low item ID.

budget_ugx.description: Spending limit in UGX. Omit if the user gave no budget.

items.description: An item ID such as ITM001, or the item's name such as 'Bic Pens (Blue)'.

priority_order.description: AI's priority ordering of every requested item ID.

supplier_choices.description: AI-selected supplier name by item ID, validated against live quotes.

supplier_reasons.description: Brief evidence-based AI rationale for each selected supplier.

priority_rationale.description: Brief evidence-based explanation of the priority order.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: List inventory items with current stock, reorder point and whether each is low. Optionally filter by category (Stationery, Office, Electronics).

category.description: Optional category name; omit for all items.

tools.name: query_purchase_history
tools.description: Past purchases of ONE item with exact totals (quantity and spend), optionally for a month range. Use for questions like 'how many pens did we buy in March 2025?'. Returns data_range so you can tell the user when a period has no data.

item.description: An item ID such as ITM001, or the item's name such as 'Bic Pens (Blue)'.

tools.name: search_policy
tools.description: Search the shop's policy and procedure documents (approval limits, payments, supplier delivery/returns/terms, reorder guidelines, supplier pressure). Returns passages with source_id. Use it for ANY policy or process question and cite the source_id; never answer policy questions from memory.
